duas.arabic:
أَمِنْ تَذَكُّرِ جِيرَانٍ بِذِي سَلَمِ
مَزَجْتَ دَمْعًا جَرَى مِنْ مُقْلَةٍ بِدَمِ

translation.en: Is it because you remember the neighbours of Dhu Salam that you have mingled tears flowing from your eyes with blood?

duas.arabic:
أَمْ هَبَّتِ الرِّيحُ مِنْ تِلْقَاءِ كَاظِمَةٍ
وَأَوْمَضَ الْبَرْقُ فِي الظَّلْمَاءِ مِنْ إِضَمِ

translation.en: Or was it the wind that rose from the side of Kazimah, and the lightning that flashed in the darkness from Idam?

duas.arabic:
فَمَا لِعَيْنَيْكَ إِنْ قُلْتَ اكْفُفَا هَمَتَا
وَمَا لِقَلْبِكَ إِنْ قُلْتَ اسْتَفِقْ يَهِمِ

translation.en: What ails your eyes, that when you tell them, “Cease,” they overflow? And what ails your heart, that when you tell it, “Awaken,” it wanders?

duas.arabic:
أَيَحْسَبُ الصَّبُّ أَنَّ الْحُبَّ مُنْكَتِمٌ
مَا بَيْنَ مُنْسَجِمٍ مِنْهُ وَمُضْطَرِمِ

translation.en: Does the lover imagine that love can be concealed, when it lies between tears spilling freely and a heart set aflame?

duas.arabic:
لَوْلَا الْهَوَى لَمْ تُرِقْ دَمْعًا عَلَى طَلَلٍ
وَلَا أَرِقْتَ لِذِكْرِ الْبَانِ وَالْعَلَمِ

translation.en: Had it not been for desire, you would not have shed tears over a ruin, nor lost your sleep recalling the slender trees and the landmark.

duas.arabic:
فَكَيْفَ تُنْكِرُ حُبًّا بَعْدَ مَا شَهِدَتْ
بِهِ عَلَيْكَ عُدُولُ الدَّمْعِ وَالسَّقَمِ

translation.en: How can you deny your love after two upright witnesses, your tears and your sickness, have testified against you?

duas.arabic:
وَأَثْبَتَ الْوَجْدُ خَطَّيْ عَبْرَةٍ وَضَنًى
مِثْلَ الْبَهَارِ عَلَى خَدَّيْكَ وَالْعَنَمِ

translation.en: Passion has inscribed upon your cheeks two lines: tears and wasting pallor, like the yellow bahar blossom and the red ʿanam.

duas.arabic:
نَعَمْ سَرَى طَيْفُ مَنْ أَهْوَى فَأَرَّقَنِي
وَالْحُبُّ يَعْتَرِضُ اللَّذَّاتِ بِالْأَلَمِ

translation.en: Yes, a vision of the one I love came to me by night and kept me awake, for love interrupts every pleasure with pain.

duas.arabic:
يَا لَائِمِي فِي الْهَوَى الْعُذْرِيِّ مَعْذِرَةً
مِنِّي إِلَيْكَ وَلَوْ أَنْصَفْتَ لَمْ تَلُمِ

translation.en: O you who reproach me for this chaste love, accept my excuse, had you been fair, you would not have blamed me.

duas.arabic:
عَدَتْكَ حَالِيَ لَا سِرِّي بِمُسْتَتِرٍ
عَنِ الْوُشَاةِ وَلَا دَائِي بِمُنْحَسِمِ

translation.en: My condition has become known to you: my secret is no longer concealed from informers, nor has my affliction come to an end.

duas.arabic:
مَحَّضْتَنِي النُّصْحَ لَكِنْ لَسْتُ أَسْمَعُهُ
إِنَّ الْمُحِبَّ عَنِ الْعُذَّالِ فِي صَمَمِ

translation.en: You offered me counsel in all sincerity, yet I cannot hear it, the lover is deaf to those who scold him.

duas.arabic:
إِنِّي اتَّهَمْتُ نَصِيحَ الشَّيْبِ فِي عَذَلٍ
وَالشَّيْبُ أَبْعَدُ فِي نُصْحٍ عَنِ التُّهَمِ

translation.en: I distrusted the counsel of grey hair when it reproached me, though grey hair is the least suspect of all counsellors.

duas.arabic:
فَإِنَّ أَمَّارَتِي بِالسُّوءِ مَا اتَّعَظَتْ
مِنْ جَهْلِهَا بِنَذِيرِ الشَّيْبِ وَالْهَرَمِ

translation.en: For my soul, ever commanding evil, has taken no heed, through its ignorance, of the warning of grey hair and old age.

duas.arabic:
وَلَا أَعَدَّتْ مِنَ الْفِعْلِ الْجَمِيلِ قِرَى
ضَيْفٍ أَلَمَّ بِرَأْسِي غَيْرَ مُحْتَشِمِ

translation.en: Nor has it prepared any hospitable offering of good deeds for the guest who descended upon my head without reserve.

duas.arabic:
لَوْ كُنْتُ أَعْلَمُ أَنِّي مَا أُوَقِّرُهُ
كَتَمْتُ سِرًّا بَدَا لِي مِنْهُ بِالْكَتَمِ

translation.en: Had I known that I would not honour this guest, I would have concealed his appearance with dye.

duas.arabic:
مَنْ لِي بِرَدِّ جِمَاحٍ مِنْ غَوَايَتِهَا
كَمَا يُرَدُّ جِمَاحُ الْخَيْلِ بِاللُّجُمِ

translation.en: Who will help me restrain the soul from its waywardness, just as a headstrong horse is restrained by bridles?

duas.arabic:
فَلَا تَرُمْ بِالْمَعَاصِي كَسْرَ شَهْوَتِهَا
إِنَّ الطَّعَامَ يُقَوِّي شَهْوَةَ النَّهِمِ

translation.en: Do not seek to break its appetite by indulging it in sins, for food only increases the appetite of the glutton.

duas.arabic:
وَالنَّفْسُ كَالطِّفْلِ إِنْ تُهْمِلْهُ شَبَّ عَلَى
حُبِّ الرَّضَاعِ وَإِنْ تَفْطِمْهُ يَنْفَطِمِ

translation.en: The soul is like a child: if you leave it unchecked, it grows attached to nursing, but if you wean it, it will be weaned.

duas.arabic:
فَاصْرِفْ هَوَاهَا وَحَاذِرْ أَنْ تُوَلِّيَهُ
إِنَّ الْهَوَى مَا تَوَلَّى يُصْمِ أَوْ يَصِمِ

translation.en: Turn its desires aside, and beware of allowing them to rule, for whenever desire takes command, it kills or disgraces.

duas.arabic:
وَرَاعِهَا وَهْيَ فِي الْأَعْمَالِ سَائِمَةٌ
وَإِنْ هِيَ اسْتَحْلَتِ الْمَرْعَى فَلَا تُسِمِ

translation.en: Watch over your soul as it grazes in the pasture of deeds, and if it finds the pasture sweet, do not let it graze unchecked.

duas.arabic:
كَمْ حَسَّنَتْ لَذَّةً لِلْمَرْءِ قَاتِلَةً
مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ يَدْرِ أَنَّ السُّمَّ فِي الدَّسَمِ

translation.en: How many a deadly pleasure has it made attractive to a man who did not realise that poison was hidden within the rich food.

duas.arabic:
وَاخْشَ الدَّسَائِسَ مِنْ جُوعٍ وَمِنْ شِبَعٍ
فَرُبَّ مَخْمَصَةٍ شَرٌّ مِنَ التُّخَمِ

translation.en: Beware the snares that come with hunger and with satiety alike, for many a pang of hunger is worse than overeating.

duas.arabic:
وَاسْتَفْرِغِ الدَّمْعَ مِنْ عَيْنٍ قَدِ امْتَلَأَتْ
مِنَ الْمَحَارِمِ وَالْزَمْ حِمْيَةَ النَّدَمِ

translation.en: Pour forth tears from eyes filled with forbidden sights, and adhere firmly to the discipline of remorse.

duas.arabic:
وَخَالِفِ النَّفْسَ وَالشَّيْطَانَ وَاعْصِهِمَا
وَإِنْ هُمَا مَحَضَاكَ النُّصْحَ فَاتَّهِمِ

translation.en: Oppose the self and Satan, and disobey them both, and even if they offer you sincere counsel, remain suspicious of them.

duas.arabic:
وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمَا خَصْمًا وَلَا حَكَمًا
فَأَنْتَ تَعْرِفُ كَيْدَ الْخَصْمِ وَالْحَكَمِ

translation.en: Obey neither of them, whether as adversary or judge, for you know the deception of both adversary and judge.

duas.arabic:
أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ مِنْ قَوْلٍ بِلَا عَمَلٍ
لَقَدْ نَسَبْتُ بِهِ نَسْلًا لِذِي عُقُمِ

translation.en: I seek Allah’s forgiveness for words that were not matched by deeds, for by doing so I have attributed offspring to one who is barren.

duas.arabic:
أَمَرْتُكَ الْخَيْرَ لَكِنْ مَا ائْتَمَرْتُ بِهِ
وَمَا اسْتَقَمْتُ فَمَا قَوْلِي لَكَ اسْتَقِمِ

translation.en: I commanded you to do good, yet did not heed it myself, I have not remained upright, so how can I tell you, “Be upright”?

duas.arabic:
وَلَا تَزَوَّدْتُ قَبْلَ الْمَوْتِ نَافِلَةً
وَلَمْ أُصَلِّ سِوَى فَرْضٍ وَلَمْ أَصُمِ

translation.en: Before death, I prepared no provision of voluntary deeds, I performed only the obligatory prayers and observed no voluntary fasts.

duas.arabic:
ظَلَمْتُ سُنَّةَ مَنْ أَحْيَا الظَّلَامَ إِلَى
أَنِ اشْتَكَتْ قَدَمَاهُ الضُّرَّ مِنْ وَرَمِ

translation.en: I have neglected the example of the one who kept the darkness alive in worship, until his feet complained of pain from their swelling.

duas.arabic:
وَشَدَّ مِنْ سَغَبٍ أَحْشَاءَهُ وَطَوَى
تَحْتَ الْحِجَارَةِ كَشْحًا مُتْرَفَ الْأَدَمِ

translation.en: From hunger, he bound his stomach tightly, placing stones against his tender side.

duas.arabic:
وَرَاوَدَتْهُ الْجِبَالُ الشُّمُّ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ
عَنْ نَفْسِهِ فَأَرَاهَا أَيَّمَا شَمَمِ

translation.en: The lofty mountains sought to tempt him by offering themselves as gold, but he showed them the loftiness of his own indifference.

duas.arabic:
وَأَكَّدَتْ زُهْدَهُ فِيهَا ضَرُورَتُهُ
إِنَّ الضَّرُورَةَ لَا تَعْدُو عَلَى الْعِصَمِ

translation.en: His need only confirmed his renunciation of them, for necessity has no power over those divinely protected.

duas.arabic:
وَكَيْفَ تَدْعُو إِلَى الدُّنْيَا ضَرُورَةُ مَنْ
لَوْلَاهُ لَمْ تُخْرَجِ الدُّنْيَا مِنَ الْعَدَمِ

translation.en: And how could need invite one to this world, when without him the world itself would never have emerged from nothing?

duas.arabic: مُحَمَّدٌ سَيِّدُ الْكَوْنَيْنِ وَالثَّقَلَيْنِ وَالْفَرِيقَيْنِ مِنْ عُرْبٍ وَمِنْ عَجَمِ

translation.en: Muhammad is the master of the two worlds and of humankind and jinn, and of both peoples: the Arabs and non-Arabs.

duas.arabic:
نَبِيُّنَا الْآمِرُ النَّاهِي فَلَا أَحَدٌ
أَبَرَّ فِي قَوْلِ لَا مِنْهُ وَلَا نَعَمِ

translation.en: Our Prophet is the one who commands and forbids: none is more truthful than he in saying “No” or “Yes.”

duas.arabic:
هُوَ الْحَبِيبُ الَّذِي تُرْجَى شَفَاعَتُهُ
لِكُلِّ هَوْلٍ مِنَ الْأَهْوَالِ مُقْتَحَمِ

translation.en: He is the Beloved whose intercession is hoped for, in the face of every overwhelming terror.

duas.arabic:
دَعَا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَالْمُسْتَمْسِكُونَ بِهِ
مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ بِحَبْلٍ غَيْرِ مُنْفَصِمِ

translation.en: He called to Allah, and those who cling to him hold fast to a rope that will never be severed.

duas.arabic:
فَاقَ النَّبِيِّينَ فِي خَلْقٍ وَفِي خُلُقٍ
وَلَمْ يُدَانُوهُ فِي عِلْمٍ وَلَا كَرَمِ

translation.en: He surpassed all prophets in form and in character, none drew near to him in knowledge or in generosity.

duas.arabic:
وَكُلُّهُمْ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ مُلْتَمِسٌ
غَرْفًا مِنَ الْبَحْرِ أَوْ رَشْفًا مِنَ الدِّيَمِ

translation.en: All of them seek from the Messenger of Allah a handful from the ocean or a sip from the unceasing rain.

duas.arabic:
وَوَاقِفُونَ لَدَيْهِ عِنْدَ حَدِّهِمِ
مِنْ نُقْطَةِ الْعِلْمِ أَوْ مِنْ شَكْلَةِ الْحِكَمِ

translation.en: They stand before him, each held to his own limit, whether at a point of his knowledge or at a vowel-mark of his wisdom.

duas.arabic:
فَهْوَ الَّذِي تَمَّ مَعْنَاهُ وَصُورَتُهُ
ثُمَّ اصْطَفَاهُ حَبِيبًا بَارِئُ النَّسَمِ

translation.en: He is the one in whom meaning and form were brought to perfection, then the Creator of all souls chose him as His Beloved.

duas.arabic:
مُنَزَّهٌ عَنْ شَرِيكٍ فِي مَحَاسِنِهِ
فَجَوْهَرُ الْحُسْنِ فِيهِ غَيْرُ مُنْقَسِمِ

translation.en: He is far above having any partner in his perfections, for the essence of beauty in him is indivisible.

duas.arabic:
دَعْ مَا ادَّعَتْهُ النَّصَارَى فِي نَبِيِّهِمِ
وَاحْكُمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ مَدْحًا فِيهِ وَاحْتَكِمِ

translation.en: Set aside what the Christians asserted about their prophet, and then pronounce whatever praise of him you wish, and judge as you will.

duas.arabic:
وَانْسُبْ إِلَى ذَاتِهِ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَرَفٍ
وَانْسُبْ إِلَى قَدْرِهِ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ عِظَمِ

translation.en: Ascribe to his very being whatever nobility you choose, and to his rank whatever greatness you will.

duas.arabic:
فَإِنَّ فَضْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ لَيْسَ لَهُ
حَدٌّ فَيُعْرِبَ عَنْهُ نَاطِقٌ بِفَمِ

translation.en: For the excellence of the Messenger of Allah has no limit that a speaker’s tongue could ever express.

duas.arabic:
لَوْ نَاسَبَتْ قَدْرَهُ آيَاتُهُ عِظَمًا
أَحْيَا اسْمُهُ حِينَ يُدْعَى دَارِسَ الرِّمَمِ

translation.en: Had his signs matched his rank in grandeur, his name, when called upon, would have revived decaying bones.

duas.arabic:
لَمْ يَمْتَحِنَّا بِمَا تَعْيَا الْعُقُولُ بِهِ
حِرْصًا عَلَيْنَا فَلَمْ نَرْتَبْ وَلَمْ نَهِمِ

translation.en: He did not burden us with what would exhaust the mind, out of care for us, so we neither wavered nor went astray.

duas.arabic:
أَعْيَا الْوَرَى فَهْمُ مَعْنَاهُ فَلَيْسَ يُرَى
فِي الْقُرْبِ وَالْبُعْدِ فِيهِ غَيْرُ مُنْفَحِمِ

translation.en: Creation is baffled in trying to comprehend his true reality, and those near and far alike are left speechless.

duas.arabic:
كَالشَّمْسِ تَظْهَرُ لِلْعَيْنَيْنِ مِنْ بُعُدٍ
صَغِيرَةً وَتُكِلُّ الطَّرْفَ مِنْ أَمَمِ

translation.en: Like the sun, he appears to the eyes from a distance, appearing small from afar, yet dazzling the eye when seen up close.

duas.arabic:
وَكَيْفَ يُدْرِكُ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَقِيقَتَهُ
قَوْمٌ نِيَامٌ تَسَلَّوْا عَنْهُ بِالْحُلُمِ

translation.en: How could his true reality ever be grasped in this world, by people asleep, diverted from him by passing dreams?

duas.arabic:
فَمَبْلَغُ الْعِلْمِ فِيهِ أَنَّهُ بَشَرٌ
وَأَنَّهُ خَيْرُ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ كُلِّهِمِ

translation.en: The utmost that knowledge attains about him is this, that he is human and that he is the best of all Allah’s creation.

duas.arabic:
وَكُلُّ آيٍ أَتَى الرُّسْلُ الْكِرَامُ بِهَا
فَإِنَّمَا اتَّصَلَتْ مِنْ نُورِهِ بِهِمِ

translation.en: Every sign the noble Messengers ever brought was connected to them only through his light.

duas.arabic:
فَإِنَّهُ شَمْسُ فَضْلٍ هُمْ كَوَاكِبُهَا
يُظْهِرْنَ أَنْوَارَهَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي الظُّلَمِ

translation.en: For he is a sun of grace, and they are its stars, revealing its lights to people in the darkness.

duas.arabic:
أَكْرِمْ بِخَلْقِ نَبِيٍّ زَانَهُ خُلُقٌ
بِالْحُسْنِ مُشْتَمِلٍ بِالْبِشْرِ مُتَّسِمِ

translation.en: How noble is the form of a Prophet adorned by noble character, enveloped in beauty and distinguished by a radiant smile.

duas.arabic:
كَالزَّهْرِ فِي تَرَفٍ وَالْبَدْرِ فِي شَرَفٍ
وَالْبَحْرِ فِي كَرَمٍ وَالدَّهْرِ فِي هِمَمِ

translation.en: Like a flower in delicacy, the full moon in splendour, the ocean in generosity, and time itself in lofty resolve.

duas.arabic:
كَأَنَّهُ وَهْوَ فَرْدٌ مِنْ جَلَالَتِهِ
فِي عَسْكَرٍ حِينَ تَلْقَاهُ وَفِي حَشَمِ

translation.en: Such is his majesty that, even when alone, he seems surrounded by an army and a retinue.

duas.arabic:
كَأَنَّمَا اللُّؤْلُؤُ الْمَكْنُونُ فِي صَدَفٍ
مِنْ مَعْدِنَيْ مَنْطِقٍ مِنْهُ وَمُبْتَسَمِ

translation.en: As though a hidden pearl lay within its shell, drawn from the twin mines of his speech and his smile.

duas.arabic:
لَا طِيبَ يَعْدِلُ تُرْبًا ضَمَّ أَعْظُمَهُ
طُوبَى لِمُنْتَشِقٍ مِنْهُ وَمُلْتَثِمِ

translation.en: No fragrance can rival the earth that enfolds his bones, blessed is the one who inhales its fragrance or kisses it.

duas.arabic:
أَبَانَ مَوْلِدُهُ عَنْ طِيبِ عُنْصُرِهِ
يَا طِيبَ مُبْتَدَإٍ مِنْهُ وَمُخْتَتَمِ

translation.en: His birth revealed the purity of his essence, how blessed was his beginning, and how blessed his end.

duas.arabic:
يَوْمٌ تَفَرَّسَ فِيهِ الْفُرْسُ أَنَّهُمُ
قَدْ أُنْذِرُوا بِحُلُولِ الْبُؤْسِ وَالنِّقَمِ

translation.en: It was a day on which the Persians discerned that misery and punishment had been announced to them.

duas.arabic:
وَبَاتَ إِيوَانُ كِسْرَى وَهْوَ مُنْصَدِعٌ
كَشَمْلِ أَصْحَابِ كِسْرَى غَيْرَ مُلْتَئِمِ

translation.en: And the palace of Kisra passed the night cracked apart, like the scattered company of Kisra, never to be reunited.

duas.arabic:
وَالنَّارُ خَامِدَةُ الْأَنْفَاسِ مِنْ أَسَفٍ
عَلَيْهِ وَالنَّهْرُ سَاهِي الْعَيْنِ مِنْ سَدَمِ

translation.en: The fire lay breathless in grief at that ruin, while the river, distracted by sorrow, forgot its course.

duas.arabic:
وَسَاءَ سَاوَةَ أَنْ غَاضَتْ بُحَيْرَتُهَا
وَرُدَّ وَارِدُهَا بِالْغَيْظِ حِينَ ظَمِي

translation.en: Sawah was distressed when its lake ran dry, and its thirsty visitors were turned away in anger.

duas.arabic:
كَأَنَّ بِالنَّارِ مَا بِالْمَاءِ مِنْ بَلَلٍ
حُزْنًا وَبِالْمَاءِ مَا بِالنَّارِ مِنْ ضَرَمِ

translation.en: As though the fire had taken on the dampness of water in grief, and the water the blaze and fervour of fire.

duas.arabic:
وَالْجِنُّ تَهْتِفُ وَالْأَنْوَارُ سَاطِعَةٌ
وَالْحَقُّ يَظْهَرُ مِنْ مَعْنًى وَمِنْ كَلِمِ

translation.en: The jinn cried out, the lights shone bright, while the truth became manifest in meaning and in speech.

duas.arabic:
عَمُوا وَصَمُّوا فَإِعْلَانُ الْبَشَائِرِ لَمْ
تُسْمَعْ وَبَارِقَةُ الْإِنْذَارِ لَمْ تُشَمِ

translation.en: They went blind and deaf so the proclamation of glad tidings was not heard, and the flash of warning was not even perceived.

duas.arabic:
مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا أَخْبَرَ الْأَقْوَامَ كَاهِنُهُمْ
بِأَنَّ دِينَهُمُ الْمُعْوَجَّ لَمْ يَقُمِ

translation.en: This was after their soothsayer had informed them that their crooked religion would no longer stand.

duas.arabic:
وَبَعْدَ مَا عَايَنُوا فِي الْأُفْقِ مِنْ شُهُبٍ
مُنْقَضَّةٍ وَفْقَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مِنْ صَنَمِ

translation.en: And after they had witnessed in the horizon meteors plunging down, falling from the sky as the idols fell upon the earth.

duas.arabic:
حَتَّى غَدَا عَنْ طَرِيقِ الْوَحْيِ مُنْهَزِمٌ
مِنَ الشَّيَاطِينِ يَقْفُو إِثْرَ مُنْهَزِمِ

translation.en: Until the devils fled in rout from the path of revelation, one fleeing devil following after another in defeat.

duas.arabic:
كَأَنَّهُمْ هَرَبًا أَبْطَالُ أَبْرَهَةٍ
أَوْ عَسْكَرٌ بِالْحَصَى مِنْ رَاحَتَيْهِ رُمِي

translation.en: As though in their flight they were Abrahah’s champions, or an army struck by pebbles cast from his own blessed palms.

duas.arabic:
نَبْذًا بِهِ بَعْدَ تَسْبِيحٍ بِبَطْنِهِمَا
نَبْذَ الْمُسَبِّحِ مِنْ أَحْشَاءِ مُلْتَقِمِ

translation.en: Pebbles cast forth after glorifying Allah within his palms, like the one who glorified Him, cast forth from the belly of the swallower.

duas.arabic:
جَاءَتْ لِدَعْوَتِهِ الْأَشْجَارُ سَاجِدَةً
تَمْشِي إِلَيْهِ عَلَى سَاقٍ بِلَا قَدَمِ

translation.en: Trees came in prostration at his call, walking towards him upon their trunks, though they had no feet.

duas.arabic:
كَأَنَّمَا سَطَرَتْ سَطْرًا لِمَا كَتَبَتْ
فُرُوعُهَا مِنْ بَدِيعِ الْخَطِّ بِاللَّقَمِ

translation.en: As though their branches had inscribed wondrous script, drawing lines upon the earth before him.

duas.arabic:
مِثْلَ الْغَمَامَةِ أَنَّى سَارَ سَائِرَةً
تَقِيهِ حَرَّ وَطِيسٍ لِلْهَجِيرِ حَمِي

translation.en: Like a drifting cloud, wherever he moved it moved as well, shielding him from the searing blaze of the midday heat.

duas.arabic:
أَقْسَمْتُ بِالْقَمَرِ الْمُنْشَقِّ إِنَّ لَهُ
مِنْ قَلْبِهِ نِسْبَةً مَبْرُورَةَ الْقَسَمِ

translation.en: I swear by the moon when it was split apart, for it bears a blessed resemblance to his heart, and the oath is true.

duas.arabic:
وَمَا حَوَى الْغَارُ مِنْ خَيْرٍ وَمِنْ كَرَمٍ
وَكُلُّ طَرْفٍ مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ عَنْهُ عَمِي

translation.en: The cave contained the very best of goodness and nobility, yet every eye of the unbelievers was blind to what it held.

duas.arabic:
فَالصِّدْقُ فِي الْغَارِ وَالصِّدِّيقُ لَمْ يَرِمَا
وَهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا بِالْغَارِ مِنْ أَرِمِ

translation.en: Truth and the Truthful One remained together in the cave, while they said, “There is no living soul within.”

duas.arabic:
ظَنُّوا الْحَمَامَ وَظَنُّوا الْعَنْكَبُوتَ عَلَى
خَيْرِ الْبَرِيَّةِ لَمْ تَنْسُجْ وَلَمْ تَحُمِ

translation.en: They supposed that no dove would nest, nor would a spider spin its web, over the Best of Creation.

duas.arabic:
وِقَايَةُ اللَّهِ أَغْنَتْ عَنْ مُضَاعَفَةٍ
مِنَ الدُّرُوعِ وَعَنْ عَالٍ مِنَ الْأُطُمِ

translation.en: Allah’s protection rendered unnecessary layers of armour, and lofty, fortified strongholds.

duas.arabic:
مَا سَامَنِي الدَّهْرُ ضَيْمًا وَاسْتَجَرْتُ بِهِ
إِلَّا وَنِلْتُ جِوَارًا مِنْهُ لَمْ يُضَمِ

translation.en: Whenever time subjected me to oppression and I sought his protection, I received from him a refuge that could not be violated.

duas.arabic:
وَلَا الْتَمَسْتُ غِنَى الدَّارَيْنِ مِنْ يَدِهِ
إِلَّا اسْتَلَمْتُ النَّدَى مِنْ خَيْرِ مُسْتَلَمِ

translation.en: Nor did I ever seek the wealth of both abodes from his hand without receiving bounty from the noblest benefactor.

duas.arabic:
لَا تُنْكِرِ الْوَحْيَ مِنْ رُؤْيَاهُ إِنَّ لَهُ
قَلْبًا إِذَا نَامَتِ الْعَيْنَانِ لَمْ يَنَمِ

translation.en: Do not deny revelation in his visions, for although his eyes slept, his heart did not.

duas.arabic:
وَذَاكَ حِينَ بُلُوغٍ مِنْ نُبُوَّتِهِ
فَلَيْسَ يُنْكَرُ فِيهِ حَالُ مُحْتَلِمِ

translation.en: This occurred at the beginning of his prophethood, for the dream of a prophet cannot be denied.

duas.arabic:
تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ مَا وَحْيٌ بِمُكْتَسَبٍ
وَلَا نَبِيٌّ عَلَى غَيْبٍ بِمُتَّهَمِ

translation.en: Blessed is Allah! Revelation is not something acquired, nor can a prophet be accused regarding the unseen.

duas.arabic:
كَمْ أَبْرَأَتْ وَصِبًا بِاللَّمْسِ رَاحَتُهُ
وَأَطْلَقَتْ أَرِبًا مِنْ رِبْقَةِ اللَّمَمِ

translation.en: How many a sick person his hand healed with a touch, and how many a madman he released from the bonds of insanity.

duas.arabic:
وَأَحْيَتِ السَّنَةَ الشَّهْبَاءَ دَعْوَتُهُ
حَتَّى حَكَتْ غُرَّةً فِي الْأَعْصُرِ الدُّهُمِ

translation.en: His supplication revived the ashen year of drought, until, amid the dark years, it shone like the white mark on a horse’s brow.

duas.arabic:
بِعَارِضٍ جَادَ أَوْ خِلْتَ الْبِطَاحَ بِهَا
سَيْبٌ مِنَ الْيَمِّ أَوْ سَيْلٌ مِنَ الْعَرِمِ

translation.en: Through a rain-cloud that poured forth until you might have thought the valleys were flooded by the sea or by the torrent of the dam of Arim.

duas.arabic:
دَعْنِي وَوَصْفِيَ آيَاتٍ لَهُ ظَهَرَتْ
ظُهُورَ نَارِ الْقِرَى لَيْلًا عَلَى عَلَمِ

translation.en: Let me describe the signs that appeared through him, as plainly as a beacon fire blazing by night upon a height.

duas.arabic:
فَالدُّرُّ يَزْدَادُ حُسْنًا وَهْوَ مُنْتَظِمٌ
وَلَيْسَ يَنْقُصُ قَدْرًا غَيْرَ مُنْتَظِمِ

translation.en: Pearls only grow more beautiful when strung in order, yet their worth is not diminished when left unstrung.

duas.arabic:
فَمَا تَطَاوُلُ آمَالِ الْمَدِيحِ إِلَى
مَا فِيهِ مِنْ كَرَمِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالشِّيَمِ

translation.en: Yet how could the highest aspirations of praise ever reach the noble character and virtues found in him?

duas.arabic:
آيَاتُ حَقٍّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ مُحْدَثَةٌ
قَدِيمَةٌ صِفَةُ الْمَوْصُوفِ بِالْقِدَمِ

translation.en: They are signs of truth from the Most Compassionate, newly revealed, yet eternal as an attribute of the One possessed of eternity.

duas.arabic:
لَمْ تَقْتَرِنْ بِزَمَانٍ وَهْيَ تُخْبِرُنَا
عَنِ الْمَعَادِ وَعَنْ عَادٍ وَعَنْ إِرَمِ

translation.en: They are not bound to any moment in time, yet they tell us of the Return, of Ad, and of Iram.

duas.arabic:
دَامَتْ لَدَيْنَا فَفَاقَتْ كُلَّ مُعْجِزَةٍ
مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ إِذْ جَاءَتْ وَلَمْ تَدُمِ

translation.en: They have remained among us and thus surpassed every miracle of the Prophets, for those miracles came but did not endure.

duas.arabic:
مُحَكَّمَاتٌ فَمَا يُبْقِينَ مِنْ شُبَهٍ
لِذِي شِقَاقٍ وَمَا يَبْغِينَ مِنْ حَكَمِ

translation.en: Decisive in judgement, they leave no doubt for one disposed to dispute, nor do they require an arbiter.

duas.arabic:
مَا حُورِبَتْ قَطُّ إِلَّا عَادَ مِنْ حَرَبٍ
أَعْدَى الْأَعَادِي إِلَيْهَا مُلْقِيَ السَّلَمِ

translation.en: Whenever they were opposed, the fiercest enemy returned from the contest submitting to them and laying down his arms.

duas.arabic:
رَدَّتْ بَلَاغَتُهَا دَعْوَى مُعَارِضِهَا
رَدَّ الْغَيُورِ يَدَ الْجَانِي عَنِ الْحُرَمِ

translation.en: Its eloquence repelled the claim of any who sought to rival it, as a protective husband repels the offender’s hand from his womenfolk.

duas.arabic:
لَهَا مَعَانٍ كَمَوْجِ الْبَحْرِ فِي مَدَدٍ
وَفَوْقَ جَوْهَرِهِ فِي الْحُسْنِ وَالْقِيَمِ

translation.en: Its meanings are as abundant as the waves of the sea, yet surpass the sea’s pearls in beauty and value.

duas.arabic:
فَمَا تُعَدُّ وَلَا تُحْصَى عَجَائِبُهَا
وَلَا تُسَامُ عَلَى الْإِكْثَارِ بِالسَّأَمِ

translation.en: Its wonders can neither be counted nor confined, nor does repeatedly reciting them ever bring weariness.

duas.arabic:
قَرَّتْ بِهَا عَيْنُ قَارِيهَا فَقُلْتُ لَهُ
لَقَدْ ظَفِرْتَ بِحَبْلِ اللَّهِ فَاعْتَصِمِ

translation.en: Its reciter’s eye finds rest in it, so I say to him, “You have grasped the rope of Allah, so hold fast to it.”

duas.arabic:
إِنْ تَتْلُهَا خِيفَةً مِنْ حَرِّ نَارِ لَظَى
أَطْفَأْتَ حَرَّ لَظَى مِنْ وِرْدِهَا الشَّبِمِ

translation.en: If you recite it out of fear of the blazing Fire of Laza, you will extinguish its heat with the cool refreshment of its daily recitation.

duas.arabic:
كَأَنَّهَا الْحَوْضُ تَبْيَضُّ الْوُجُوهُ بِهِ
مِنَ الْعُصَاةِ وَقَدْ جَاؤُوهُ كَالْحُمَمِ

translation.en: It is like the prophetic Basin, by which the faces of sinners are illumined, though they approach it dark as charcoal.

duas.arabic:
وَكَالصِّرَاطِ وَكَالْمِيزَانِ مَعْدِلَةً
فَالْقِسْطُ مِنْ غَيْرِهَا فِي النَّاسِ لَمْ يَقُمِ

translation.en: It is like the Bridge and the Balance in its perfect justice, for without it, justice among people could never stand.

duas.arabic:
لَا تَعْجَبَنْ لِحَسُودٍ رَاحَ يُنْكِرُهَا
تَجَاهُلًا وَهْوَ عَيْنُ الْحَاذِقِ الْفَهِمِ

translation.en: Do not be astonished at an envious man who knowingly denies it, feigning ignorance despite being perceptive and learned.

duas.arabic:
قَدْ تُنْكِرُ الْعَيْنُ ضَوْءَ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ رَمَدٍ
وَيُنْكِرُ الْفَمُ طَعْمَ الْمَاءِ مِنْ سَقَمِ

translation.en: An ailing eye may deny the light of the sun, and a sick mouth may deny the taste of water.

duas.arabic:
يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ يَمَّمَ الْعَافُونَ سَاحَتَهُ
سَعْيًا وَفَوْقَ مُتُونِ الْأَيْنُقِ الرُّسُمِ

translation.en: O best of those to whose courtyard seekers of bounty journey, travelling on foot and upon the backs of swift, lean she-camels.

duas.arabic:
وَمَنْ هُوَ الْآيَةُ الْكُبْرَى لِمُعْتَبِرٍ
وَمَنْ هُوَ النِّعْمَةُ الْعُظْمَى لِمُغْتَنِمِ

translation.en: And who is the greatest sign for one who reflects, and the greatest blessing for one who seeks to benefit from it.

duas.arabic:
سَرَيْتَ مِنْ حَرَمٍ لَيْلًا إِلَى حَرَمٍ
كَمَا سَرَى الْبَدْرُ فِي دَاجٍ مِنَ الظُّلَمِ

translation.en: You journeyed by night from one sacred precinct to another, as the full moon glides through the depths of darkness.

duas.arabic:
وَبِتَّ تَرْقَى إِلَى أَنْ نِلْتَ مَنْزِلَةً
مِنْ قَابِ قَوْسَيْنِ لَمْ تُدْرَكْ وَلَمْ تُرَمِ

translation.en: And you spent the night ascending, until you reached a station of “two bow-lengths,” never attained nor even aspired to.

duas.arabic:
وَقَدَّمَتْكَ جَمِيعُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ بِهَا
وَالرُّسْلِ تَقْدِيمَ مَخْدُومٍ عَلَى خَدَمِ

translation.en: By it, all the Prophets and Messengers set you forward, giving you precedence as a master is given precedence over servants.

duas.arabic:
وَأَنْتَ تَخْتَرِقُ السَّبْعَ الطِّبَاقَ بِهِمْ
فِي مَوْكِبٍ كُنْتَ فِيهِ صَاحِبَ الْعَلَمِ

translation.en: You passed through the seven layered heavens with them, in a procession in which you were the eminent leader.

duas.arabic:
حَتَّى إِذَا لَمْ تَدَعْ شَأْوًا لِمُسْتَبِقٍ
مِنَ الدُّنُوِّ وَلَا مَرْقًى لِمُسْتَنِمِ

translation.en: Until you left no goal of nearness for any competitor, and no height for any climber to attain.

duas.arabic:
خَفَضْتَ كُلَّ مَقَامٍ بِالْإِضَافَةِ إِذْ
نُودِيتَ بِالرَّفْعِ مِثْلَ الْمُفْرَدِ الْعَلَمِ

translation.en: Every other rank fell below yours, when you were called by name and raised on high.

duas.arabic:
كَيْمَا تَفُوزَ بِوَصْلٍ أَيِّ مُسْتَتِرٍ
عَنِ الْعُيُونِ وَسِرٍّ أَيِّ مُكْتَتَمِ

translation.en: So that you might attain a communion utterly hidden from all eyes, and a secret concealed beyond all concealment.

duas.arabic:
فَحُزْتَ كُلَّ فَخَارٍ غَيْرَ مُشْتَرَكٍ
وَجُزْتَ كُلَّ مَقَامٍ غَيْرَ مُزْدَحَمِ

translation.en: Thus you attained every honour without any partner, and passed beyond every station without competition.

duas.arabic:
وَجَلَّ مِقْدَارُ مَا وُلِّيتَ مِنْ رُتَبٍ
وَعَزَّ إِدْرَاكُ مَا أُولِيتَ مِنْ نِعَمِ

translation.en: How exalted are the ranks with which you were invested, and how impossible it is to comprehend the blessings you were granted.

duas.arabic:
بُشْرَى لَنَا مَعْشَرَ الْإِسْلَامِ إِنَّ لَنَا
مِنَ الْعِنَايَةِ رُكْنًا غَيْرَ مُنْهَدِمِ

translation.en: Glad tidings to us, O community of Islam! For through divine care we possess a pillar that will never collapse.

duas.arabic:
لَمَّا دَعَا اللَّهُ دَاعِينَا لِطَاعَتِهِ
بِأَكْرَمِ الرُّسْلِ كُنَّا أَكْرَمَ الْأُمَمِ

translation.en: Allah named the one who calls us to obey Him the noblest of Messengers, and so we became the noblest of nations.

duas.arabic:
رَاعَتْ قُلُوبَ الْعِدَا أَنْبَاءُ بِعْثَتِهِ
كَنَبْأَةٍ أَجْفَلَتْ غُفْلًا مِنَ الْغَنَمِ

translation.en: The news of his mission struck terror into the hearts of enemies, like a sudden cry that scatters an unwary flock of sheep.

duas.arabic:
مَا زَالَ يَلْقَاهُمُ فِي كُلِّ مُعْتَرَكٍ
حَتَّى حَكَوْا بِالْقَنَا لَحْمًا عَلَى وَضَمِ

translation.en: He kept meeting them on every battlefield, until, beneath the spears, the enemy resembled meat laid upon a butcher’s block.

duas.arabic:
وَدُّوا الْفِرَارَ فَكَادُوا يَغْبِطُونَ بِهِ
أَشْلَاءَ شَالَتْ مَعَ الْعِقْبَانِ وَالرَّخَمِ

translation.en: They longed to flee, almost envying the scattered limbs carried off by eagles and vultures.

duas.arabic:
تَمْضِي اللَّيَالِي وَلَا يَدْرُونَ عِدَّتَهَا
مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ مِنْ لَيَالِي الْأَشْهُرِ الْحُرُمِ

translation.en: The nights passed, and they could not count them, except when they fell within the sacred months.

duas.arabic:
كَأَنَّمَا الدِّينُ ضَيْفٌ حَلَّ سَاحَتَهُمْ
بِكُلِّ قَرْمٍ إِلَى لَحْمِ الْعِدَا قَرِمِ

translation.en: It was as though Islam were a guest who had descended into their camp, accompanied by every valiant warrior hungry for the enemy’s flesh.

duas.arabic:
يَجُرُّ بَحْرَ خَمِيسٍ فَوْقَ سَابِحَةٍ
يَرْمِي بِمَوْجٍ مِنَ الْأَبْطَالِ مُلْتَطِمِ

translation.en: He led an ocean-like army upon swift horses, casting forth surging waves of heroes.

duas.arabic:
مِنْ كُلِّ مُنْتَدِبٍ لِلَّهِ مُحْتَسِبٍ
يَسْطُو بِمُسْتَأْصِلٍ لِلْكُفْرِ مُصْطَلِمِ

translation.en: It was formed of volunteers devoted to Allah and seeking His reward, each attacking with weapons that uprooted and annihilated disbelief.

duas.arabic:
حَتَّى غَدَتْ مِلَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ وَهْيَ بِهِمْ
مِنْ بَعْدِ غُرْبَتِهَا مَوْصُولَةَ الرَّحِمِ

translation.en: Until the faith of Islam, through them, after its estrangement, became reunited with its family.

duas.arabic:
مَكْفُولَةً أَبَدًا مِنْهُمْ بِخَيْرِ أَبٍ
وَخَيْرِ بَعْلٍ فَلَمْ تَيْتَمْ وَلَمْ تَئِمِ

translation.en: Forever protected by them, with the finest father, and the finest husband, she was neither orphaned nor widowed.

duas.arabic:
هُمُ الْجِبَالُ فَسَلْ عَنْهُمْ مُصَادِمَهُمْ
مَاذَا رَأَى مِنْهُمُ فِي كُلِّ مُصْطَدَمِ

translation.en: They are mountains: ask those who confronted them what they witnessed in every encounter.

duas.arabic:
وَسَلْ حُنَيْنًا وَسَلْ بَدْرًا وَسَلْ أُحُدًا
فُصُولَ حَتْفٍ لَهُمْ أَدْهَى مِنَ الْوَخَمِ

translation.en: Ask Hunayn, ask Badr, ask Uhud, scenes of death for the enemy, more dreadful than a devastating plague.

duas.arabic:
الْمُصْدِرِي الْبِيضِ حُمْرًا بَعْدَ مَا وَرَدَتْ
مِنَ الْعِدَا كُلَّ مُسْوَدٍّ مِنَ اللِّمَمِ

translation.en: They sent back white blades stained red, after those blades had entered every black-haired enemy.

duas.arabic:
وَالْكَاتِبِينَ بِسُمْرِ الْخَطِّ مَا تَرَكَتْ
أَقْلَامُهُمْ حَرْفَ جِسْمٍ غَيْرَ مُنْعَجِمِ

translation.en: And they wrote, with brown lances, a script whose strokes left no letter of a body without its diacritical mark.

duas.arabic:
شَاكِي السِّلَاحِ لَهُمْ سِيمَا تُمَيِّزُهُمْ
وَالْوَرْدُ يَمْتَازُ بِالسِّيمَا عَنِ السَّلَمِ

translation.en: Fully armed, they bore a distinguishing mark, as the red rose is set apart from the pale acacia by its hue.

duas.arabic:
تُهْدِي إِلَيْكَ رِيَاحُ النَّصْرِ نَشْرَهُمُ
فَتَحْسَبُ الزَّهْرَ فِي الْأَكْمَامِ كُلَّ كَمِي

translation.en: The winds of victory carry their fragrance to you, so that every bud seems a hidden warrior within its sheath.

duas.arabic:
كَأَنَّهُمْ فِي ظُهُورِ الْخَيْلِ نَبْتُ رُبًا
مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْحَزْمِ لَا مِنْ شَدَّةِ الْحُزُمِ

translation.en: Upon the horses’ backs they seemed like plants rooted on hilltops, held firm by the strength of their resolve, not by the tightness of their saddles.

duas.arabic:
طَارَتْ قُلُوبُ الْعِدَا مِنْ بَأْسِهِمْ فَرَقًا
فَمَا تُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ الْبَهْمِ وَالْبُهَمِ

translation.en: The hearts of the enemy took flight in terror at their might, until they could no longer distinguish lambs from valiant warriors.

duas.arabic:
وَمَنْ تَكُنْ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ نُصْرَتُهُ
إِنْ تَلْقَهُ الْأُسْدُ فِي آجَامِهَا تَجِمِ

translation.en: Whoever has the Messenger of Allah as his support, even lions will shrink back when they meet him in their thickets.

duas.arabic:
وَلَنْ تَرَى مِنْ وَلِيٍّ غَيْرَ مُنْتَصِرٍ
بِهِ وَلَا مِنْ عَدُوٍّ غَيْرَ مُنْقَصِمِ

translation.en: You will never see any ally of his except victorious through him, nor an enemy except shattered and undone.

duas.arabic:
أَحَلَّ أُمَّتَهُ فِي حِرْزِ مِلَّتِهِ
كَاللَّيْثِ حَلَّ مَعَ الْأَشْبَالِ فِي أَجَمِ

translation.en: He settled his community within the safeguard of his faith, like a lion dwelling with its cubs in the thicket.

duas.arabic:
كَمْ جَدَّلَتْ كَلِمَاتُ اللَّهِ مِنْ جَدِلٍ
فِيهِ وَكَمْ خَصَمَ الْبُرْهَانُ مِنْ خَصِمِ

translation.en: How many a stubborn opponent Allah’s words have cast down through him, and how many an adversary proof itself has silenced.

duas.arabic:
كَفَاكَ بِالْعِلْمِ فِي الْأُمِّيِّ مُعْجِزَةً
فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَالتَّأْدِيبِ فِي الْيُتُمِ

translation.en: Sufficient as a miracle is the knowledge of one unlettered in the Age of Ignorance, and the refinement of one raised as an orphan.

duas.arabic:
خَدَمْتُهُ بِمَدِيحٍ أَسْتَقِيلُ بِهِ
ذُنُوبَ عُمْرٍ مَضَى فِي الشِّعْرِ وَالْخِدَمِ

translation.en: I have served him with praise, seeking through it pardon, for the sins of a lifetime spent in poetry and service.

duas.arabic:
إِذْ قَلَّدَانِيَ مَا تُخْشَى عَوَاقِبُهُ
كَأَنَّنِي بِهِمَا هَدْيٌ مِنَ النَّعَمِ

translation.en: For poetry and service placed around my neck consequences to be feared, until I seemed like a sacrificial animal led by its garlands.

duas.arabic:
أَطَعْتُ غَيَّ الصِّبَا فِي الْحَالَتَيْنِ وَمَا
حَصَلْتُ إِلَّا عَلَى الْآثَامِ وَالنَّدَمِ

translation.en: In both pursuits, I obeyed the misguidance of youth, and gained from it nothing but sins and remorse.

duas.arabic:
فَيَا خَسَارَةَ نَفْسٍ فِي تِجَارَتِهَا
لَمْ تَشْتَرِ الدِّينَ بِالدُّنْيَا وَلَمْ تَسُمِ

translation.en: What a disastrous bargain my soul has made! It neither purchased religion with the world nor even bargained for it.

duas.arabic:
وَمَنْ يَبِعْ آجِلًا مِنْهُ بِعَاجِلِهِ
يَبِنْ لَهُ الْغَبْنُ فِي بَيْعٍ وَفِي سَلَمِ

translation.en: Whoever sells his Hereafter for his present world will plainly see his loss, whether in an immediate sale or deferred transaction.

duas.arabic:
إِنْ آتِ ذَنْبًا فَمَا عَهْدِي بِمُنْتَقِضٍ
مِنَ النَّبِيِّ وَلَا حَبْلِي بِمُنْصَرِمِ

translation.en: If I fall into sin, my covenant remains unbroken with the Prophet, and the rope that binds me to him remains intact.

duas.arabic:
فَإِنَّ لِي ذِمَّةً مِنْهُ بِتَسْمِيَتِي
مُحَمَّدًا وَهْوَ أَوْفَى الْخَلْقِ بِالذِّمَمِ

translation.en: For I have a covenant with him through sharing the name, Muhammad, and he is the most faithful of creation in honouring covenants.

duas.arabic:
إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي مَعَادِي آخِذًا بِيَدِي
فَضْلًا وَإِلَّا فَقُلْ يَا زَلَّةَ الْقَدَمِ

translation.en: If, on the Day of Return, he does not take me by the hand in grace, then say: “Alas, for the foot that slipped.”

duas.arabic:
حَاشَاهُ أَنْ يَحْرِمَ الرَّاجِي مَكَارِمَهُ
أَوْ يَرْجِعَ الْجَارُ مِنْهُ غَيْرَ مُحْتَرَمِ

translation.en: Far be it from him to deny his generosity to one who hopes in it, or for one who seeks his protection to return from him without honour.

duas.arabic:
وَمُنْذُ أَلْزَمْتُ أَفْكَارِي مَدَائِحَهُ
وَجَدْتُهُ لِخَلَاصِي خَيْرَ مُلْتَزِمِ

translation.en: Since I bound my thoughts to praising him, I have found him the truest guarantor of my deliverance.

duas.arabic:
وَلَنْ يَفُوتَ الْغِنَى مِنْهُ يَدًا تَرِبَتْ
إِنَّ الْحَيَا يُنْبِتُ الْأَزْهَارَ فِي الْأَكَمِ

translation.en: His bounty will not pass by a hand left bare, for rain causes flowers to bloom even upon barren hills.

duas.arabic:
وَلَمْ أُرِدْ زَهْرَةَ الدُّنْيَا الَّتِي اقْتَطَفَتْ
يَدَا زُهَيْرٍ بِمَا أَثْنَى عَلَى هَرِمِ

translation.en: I did not seek the flower of worldly wealth that Zuhayr’s hands gathered through the praise he offered to Harim.

duas.arabic:
يَا أَكْرَمَ الْخَلْقِ مَا لِي مَنْ أَلُوذُ بِهِ
سِوَاكَ عِنْدَ حُلُولِ الْحَادِثِ الْعَمِمِ

translation.en: O noblest of creation, I have no one with whom to seek refuge but you when the universal calamity descends.

duas.arabic:
وَلَنْ يَضِيقَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ جَاهُكَ بِي
إِذَا الْكَرِيمُ تَجَلَّى بِاسْمِ مُنْتَقِمِ

translation.en: O Messenger of Allah, your honoured standing will not fail me when the Generous One reveals Himself as the Avenger.

duas.arabic:
فَإِنَّ مِنْ جُودِكَ الدُّنْيَا وَضَرَّتَهَا
وَمِنْ عُلُومِكَ عِلْمَ اللَّوْحِ وَالْقَلَمِ

translation.en: For from your generosity come this world and the next alike, and from your knowledge, the knowledge of the Tablet and the Pen.

duas.arabic:
يَا نَفْسُ لَا تَقْنَطِي مِنْ زَلَّةٍ عَظُمَتْ
إِنَّ الْكَبَائِرَ فِي الْغُفْرَانِ كَاللَّمَمِ

translation.en: O soul, do not despair because of a fault however grave, for even the greatest sins, in forgiveness, are like minor slips.

duas.arabic:
لَعَلَّ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّي حِينَ يَقْسِمُهَا
تَأْتِي عَلَى حَسَبِ الْعِصْيَانِ فِي الْقِسَمِ

translation.en: Perhaps my Lord’s mercy, when He distributes it, will come in shares proportionate to the magnitude of disobedience.

duas.arabic:
يَا رَبِّ وَاجْعَلْ رَجَائِي غَيْرَ مُنْعَكِسٍ
لَدَيْكَ وَاجْعَلْ حِسَابِي غَيْرَ مُنْخَرِمِ

translation.en: O Lord, let my hope with You not be turned back, and do not allow my account before You to be ruined.

duas.arabic:
وَالْطُفْ بِعَبْدِكَ فِي الدَّارَيْنِ إِنَّ لَهُ
صَبْرًا مَتَى تَدْعُهُ الْأَهْوَالُ يَنْهَزِمِ

translation.en: Deal gently with Your slave in both abodes, for his patience flees whenever terrors summon him.

duas.arabic:
وَأْذَنْ لِسُحْبِ صَلَاةٍ مِنْكَ دَائِمَةٍ
عَلَى النَّبِيِّ بِمُنْهَلٍّ وَمُنْسَجِمِ

translation.en: Grant leave for clouds of unceasing prayers from You to pour abundantly and continuously upon the Prophet.

duas.arabic:
مَا رَنَّحَتْ عَذَبَاتِ الْبَانِ رِيحُ صَبًا
وَأَطْرَبَ الْعِيسَ حَادِي الْعِيسِ بِالنَّغَمِ

translation.en: As long as the east wind sways the supple branches of the ban, and the camel-driver’s melody delights the white camels.

duas.arabic:
ثُمَّ الرِّضَا عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعَنْ عُمَرَ
وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ وَعَنْ عُثْمَانَ ذِي الْكَرَمِ

translation.en: Then may Allah be pleased with Abu Bakr and Umar, and with Ali and Uthman, the possessor of noble virtue.

duas.arabic:
وَالْآلِ وَالصَّحْبِ ثُمَّ التَّابِعِينَ فَهُمْ
أَهْلُ التُّقَى وَالنَّقَى وَالْحِلْمِ وَالْكَرَمِ

translation.en: And with the Prophet’s Family and Companions, and then the Followers, they are the people of piety, purity, forbearance and generosity.

duas.arabic:
يَا رَبِّ بِالْمُصْطَفَى بَلِّغْ مَقَاصِدَنَا
وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا مَا مَضَى يَا وَاسِعَ الْكَرَمِ

translation.en: O Lord, by the Chosen One, bring our aims to fulfilment, and forgive us for what has passed, O One of boundless generosity.

duas.arabic:
وَاغْفِرْ إِلَهِي لِكُلِّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ بِمَا
يَتْلُونَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْأَقْصَى وَفِي الْحَرَمِ

translation.en: My God, forgive all Muslims through the blessing of what they recite in al-Aqsa Mosque and within the Sacred Sanctuary.

duas.arabic:
بِجَاهِ مَنْ بَيْتُهُ فِي طَيْبَةٍ حَرَمٌ
وَاسْمُهُ قَسَمٌ مِنْ أَعْظَمِ الْقَسَمِ

translation.en: By the rank of him whose home in Taybah is a sanctuary, and whose very name is an oath among the greatest of oaths.

duas.arabic:
وَهَذِهِ بُرْدَةُ الْمُخْتَارِ قَدْ خُتِمَتْ
وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فِي بَدْءٍ وَفِي خَتَمِ

translation.en: This is the Burdah of the Chosen One, now brought to its close, and praise belongs to Allah at the beginning and at the end.

duas.arabic:
أَبْيَاتُهَا قَدْ أَتَتْ سِتِّينَ مَعْ مِائَةٍ
فَرِّجْ بِهَا كَرْبَنَا يَا وَاسِعَ الْكَرَمِ

translation.en: Its verses have reached one hundred and sixty, through them relieve our distress, O One of boundless generosity.
